description: Measure a project with codometer and gate the limits it declares. Batched, so one process measures every project Nx hands it.

check.description: Fail the task when a limit the project declares is breached, after any report is written.

command.description: Required. The shell command that starts the codometer command line, to which `batch` and its flags are appended.

config.description: Required. The codometer configuration file, relative to the project root. It is never searched for.

onlyInputs.description: Measure only these configured inputs, by name; the others, and the limits written against them, are left out.

outputJson.description: Where to write the JSON report, relative to the project root. No report is written without it.

outputMarkdown.description: Where to write the markdown badge block, relative to the project root.

title: Codometer measure
